title_en: Technology and Engineering (14/20): Installing Solar Panels on the Roof
note_en: The 把 construction moves the object in front of the verb so the sentence can say what happens to it: 再把太阳能板一块块地装上去 "then they mounted the solar panels one by one." English just says "verb + object," but in Chinese 把 is the natural choice when a definite object is moved, changed or put somewhere, and the verb can't stand bare: it needs a result or direction after it, like 上去 or 好.
